messages:
Priya (PM): Quick async check for the quarter milestone sprint — two buckets: runtime-v2 perf (OKR A.1) and Dedicated GA (OKR B.2). Reply with: shipped / slipped, owner, blocker(s), ETA. If you need reviews, paste CRs and @reviewer pings.

Sam (Eng-runtime): runtime-v2: shipped perf patches for attention optimizations and KV cache improvements. Canary running at 25% in us-west. No perf regressions observed on 512B sequence profile. Owner: Sam. Blocker: small CR (#421) waiting on load test signoff. ETA for full rollout: 3 business days once CR lands.

Alice (Eng-platform): Dedicated GA: autoscale e2e tests failed in 2 failure modes (graceful node drain + cold-start latency). Owner: Alice. Slipped by 1 week to address node quiesce bug. Blocker: infra fix (Jules) + one more round of perf test. New ETA: 2026-04-03.

Jules (SRE): I can take the quiesce fix, looking at the kube-drain path now. Will have a patch by EOD tomorrow. FYI dedicated GA requires canary policy change too (reduce burst to 20%).

Mei (Design): Docs & onboard flows: core runtime guide updated and pushed to staging; Dedicated onboarding checklist still missing the KMS/KV note. Owner: Mei. ETA for final docs: 4 days.

Priya (PM): Thanks — quick asks: Sam please paste CR link and @alice once load test signoff done. Alice/Jules, once you have the patch, can we lock an org-wide freeze window for the GA rollout? Also add short rollback steps to the checklist.

Sam (Eng-runtime): CR: https://git.redwood/infra/421 — @alice PTAL for load test signoff. Load test plan: run 1000 req/s sustained for 30m with 99p latency target.

Alice (Eng-platform): @Sam will run the load test when Jules confirms the quiesce patch. Agree on a 2-hour org freeze window for the GA rollout. I’ll add rollback steps to the checklist.

Jules (SRE): Patch pushed: `fix/node-quiesce-ctl` -> rolling test in staging. Will report back in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for runtime-v2 at 2026-03-02T16:12:15Z (25% traffic). Monitor: /dash/runtime/canary.

Priya (PM): Perfect — last items: please update the milestone board (A.1, B.2) with shipped/slipped + ETA. I’ll compile a short status for execs tomorrow. If anything slips further, call it out in this thread. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng-runtime): Noted. I’ll follow up after load test.

Alice (Eng-platform): Will update the board after Jules confirms staging tests.

Jules (SRE): Staging tests green. Moving to canary patch tomorrow morning.

Priya (PM): Awesome, thanks everyone.
